data.title: DRIFT EXPLOITER MOVES $32M $Ethereum (ETH.CC)$ AFTER 2 MONTHS  The Drift Protocol exploiter is active again, sending at least 13.4K $Ethereum (ETH.CC)$ (~$32M) to Tornado Cash, potentially to obscure the fund trail.  Still holds $224.59M across tracked wallets:  · 93.965K $Ethereum (ETH.CC)$ ($224.04M) · 477.375K $Pacific Global Etf Trust Us Equity Income Etf (USDY.US)$ ($548.98K) · 1.33 $SOL ($138)
